svg.title: Elemental selenium powder
svg.desc: Analytically pure powder. Typical characterization solution is selenium-saturated ethylenediamine; saturation concentration and absolute mass are unreported. No selenium allotrope or molecular geometry is assigned. In the benzene and tetrahydrofuran controls, selenium powder does not dissolve; the successful ethylenediamine route instead uses a selenium-saturated solution. No amount or selenium phase specified. Identity reference only; no measured geometry.

g.text: Source quantities and mixture limits remain in the protocol.
